workflow_gate: A substantive radar finding is not complete until GitHub write succeeds and read-back verifies the permanent ID and card.
radar_rules: For every industry, independently identify substances/mixtures actually used or generated and test chemical, physical and biological factors against current SanPiN/SP requirements and Rospotrebnadzor checklists; do not wait for industry-specific sources to mention them.

MANDATORY MARKING↔ROP LAYER: for every goods/product industry, check whether mandatory marking applies for the relevant period; if yes, reconcile GIS MT roles/product/introduction data with factual manufacturer/importer, PP RF No.2414 ROP scope, obligated entity and ROP mass/reporting. Marking does not itself create ROP obligation; it is an independent control/evidence source.
radar_source_contours: Rospotrebnadzor: sanitary rules, complaints, enforcement, checklists, laboratory measurements
Rostekhnadzor: industrial safety/OPO where technology triggers it
Rosrybolovstvo: aquatic biological resources and approvals
Rosselkhoznadzor/veterinary control: biological waste, animal by-products, veterinary-sanitary contours
MChS/fire supervision: fire/explosion/chemical-storage and emergency contours
Rostransnadzor: dangerous-goods transport and transport safety
Rosleskhoz/regional forest supervision: forest use/protection/fire-safety contours
Rosreestr/regional land supervision: land-use/land-condition contours where applicable

measurement_model.rule: Exclude occupational-safety/SOUT analysis. Measure and investigate factors only where they form a sanitary-epidemiological, population-impact, SZZ, environmental, waste/water/air/process or other MIRLEX-relevant compliance contour.

scope_exclusions: OCCUPATIONAL_SAFETY_LABOR_PROTECTION: exclude as a standalone MIRLEX radar/service contour. Do not scan Rostrud/GIT, SOUT, PPE, medical examinations or workplace labor-protection compliance as independent targets. Retain sanitary/epidemiological, environmental and population-impact factors (chemicals, biological factors, noise, vibration, light, EMF etc.) only where they are relevant to sanitary rules, environmental impact, SZZ, territory, waste/water/air/process or Rospotrebnadzor requirements.
